subject: [AMBER] TI data collection of DU/Dlambda at constant volume

messages.author: Debarati DasGupta
messages.body:
Hi All,
In the 3 papers I read, the authors have always used 10-20ns of constant volume (NVT) productions to perform GPU-accelerated TI runs on AMBER. Any specific reason for doing NVT to collect the DU-DLambda values and not NPT? Am I missing out on something fundamental?
Thanks
